- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 1.3) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast peak by 5–10%.
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -1.0), model underestimates; adjust downward by 3–7% to avoid missing downside momentum.
- Model consistently overreacts to recent spikes (e.g., +10%+ above 70) — cap forecast rise to 8–10% after a spike.
- Forecast mean reversion bias: if 30d forecast is > 75, reduce by 2–5% unless sentiment supports continuation.
- If sentiment shifts from negative to positive within 5 days, model lags — adjust forecast 1–2 days ahead of true trend reversal.
- For 30d horizon, avoid “overfitting” to recent 7–14d data — use 18d history as anchor, not 30d trend.
